messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "continue even if no immediate improvement"
set: ["continue even if no immediate improvement", "continue using even if feeling well", "keep taking even if no change felt yet", "continue to take tablets even if you feel well", "continue use for high blood pressure even if feeling fine", "this is true even if you have no symptoms", "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure", "seek immediate medical care if signs observed", "even if blood sugar is normal", "seek immediate medical care if you notice these signs", "keep taking even if you feel well", "keep using even if you feel well", "do this even if you feel well", "do this even if you are feeling well", "read information every time even if taken before", "keep using carvedilol even if you feel well"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "continue using even if feeling well",
    "keep taking even if no change felt yet",
    "continue to take tablets even if you feel well",
    "continue use even if feeling well",
    "continue use even if feeling well when treating high blood pressure",
    "keep taking even if you feel well",
    "keep using even if you feel well",
    "do this even if you feel well",
    "do this even if you are feeling well"
  ],
  "alias": "continue using even if feeling well"
}
